name: Phase 4 — GPS Device Data Ingestion Webhook

content.description: Webhook endpoint that receives raw GPS position data from IoT tracking devices attached to containers (reefers, high-value cargo). Writes directly to iot_container_gps_trackings with trackingType 'real_time'. Supports batch ingestion of multiple position reports in a single call.
capabilities: POST /api/v1/tracking/gps-ingest — receives GPS device position reports
Accepts single position or batch array of positions
Each position: deviceId, containerNumber (optional), lat, lng, speed, heading, altitude, batteryLevel, signalStrength, timestamp
Batch limit: max 100 positions per request
acceptance_criteria: Single position POST returns 201 with tracking record ID
Batch position POST returns 201 with array of tracking record IDs
Containers appear on map at GPS coordinates after ingest + refresh
Battery level and signal strength stored when provided
Zod validation on request body — 422 on invalid payload
Auth: Bearer token (iot:read) OR X-Webhook-Signature HMAC-SHA256
edge_cases: Device not linked to any container — creates record with null containerNumber
Batch with mix of valid and invalid positions — reject entire batch (atomic)
GPS coordinates outside valid range (lat >90 or lng >180) — Zod rejects
Very frequent reports (every 10s from same device) — all stored (no dedup on real_time)
Battery level 0% — accepted, could indicate device dying
Signal strength negative (dBm) — accepted as integer
error_handling: Batch >100 items — 400 'Batch size exceeds limit of 100'
DB error — 500 generic message, log full error server-side
